messages:
olivia: quick RFC follow-up — thinking about decoupling eviction semantics from prefix 'pin' lifetime. idea: introduce an explicit eviction_grace token that's orthogonal to the pin API. motivation: hard to reason about fairness when pins implicitly extend eviction windows and we leak pin-side effects across tenants (esp. Dedicated/private). :thinking:

sam: can you sketch the surface change? is this just metadata on the prefix lease or a new RPC?

olivia: sketch: add a small optional header/field on AcquirePin and ReleasePin: `eviction_grace_id` (opaque string). runtime keeps a separate lightweight record keyed by eviction_grace_id that controls soft->hard demotion windows. pins still exist for correctness, but grace is explicit and transferable. example: AcquirePin(prefix, pin_id, eviction_grace_id="g-1234")

mike: so eviction_grace_id can outlive pins? risk: dangling grace records accumulating. need TTL/GC policy.

olivia: yes TTL planned. lifecycle: create on first mention, TTL refreshed by any holder of that grace id. GC after TTL + safety margin. we'll expose counts in telemetry.

aina: how does this interact with handoff? if node A hands prefix to B while grace is active, B must import the grace state or consult central service. are we adding a central reconcile point?

olivia: two options: 1) piggyback grace transfer on existing handoff RPC (cheap, local), 2) central grace directory service (eventual). prefer 1 for now to avoid extra moving parts; fallback if handoff misses.

sam: piggybacking is simplest but breaks cross-cluster/private deployments where handoff paths differ. maybe hybrid: primary piggyback, with a small, optional reconcile endpoint used only for rare handoff misses.

mike: important: what are invariants we must preserve? i) no eviction while any pin exists, ii) no hard-demote before grace expires unless explicit admin action, iii) idempotent handoffs.

olivia: agree. propose we keep invariant (i) enforced locally w/ pin metadata; eviction_grace only affects soft->hard demotion timing, never overrides pin protection. enforcement: eviction controller checks both pin_count==0 && grace_expired before hard demote.

jean: how about correctness hazards: what if two nodes refresh grace concurrently and time drift causes double GC? we need monotonic leases or epoch tags on grace id updates.

olivia: plan: grace record = {id, epoch, last_refresh_ts, origin_node}. refresh requires bumping epoch and writing a monotonic counter to local handoff log. handoff transfers epoch too. avoids stale overwrites.

aina: telemetry/alerts? we should add metrics: grace_count, avg_grace_duration, grace_gc_lag, handoff_miss_rate, evict-blocked-by-grace. those will help validate correctness after rollout.

olivia: agreed. canary plan: small cluster opt-in flag `enable_eviction_grace` per node. start with internal dev cluster, run prefix-heavy loads, measure GC growth + miss rate. if stable, roll to edge nodes.

sam: any API compatibility issues for SDKs? AcquirePin signature changes, but eviction_grace_id can be optional and defaulted to empty. no user-visible change unless they adopt the grace semantics.

mike: performance: extra checks on eviction path — cheap but worth microbenchmark. also storage: grace records per-hot-prefix; should be tiny. propose limit grace records per-shard and LRU eviction of least-recent grace ids when high.

olivia: outstanding questions: 1) GC policy numbers (TTL, safety margin) — propose TTL=30s, safety margin=10s to start. 2) whether grace should be transferable across regions — start single-cluster only. 3) admin override API to force expire grace for ops.

jean: +1 to admin override. also add a debug endpoint to list active grace ids for a prefix to help oncall.

aina: I'll draft a follow-up RFC bullet list and experiment checklist. will include migration steps and telemetry dashboards.

olivia: thanks — I'll open a short RFC PR with API snippets and smoke test plan. tagging @infra-bot to create canary infra ticket. :wave:

infra-bot: created ticket INFRA-1098 for canary rollout and resources (assigned to eng-runtime on-call).

sam: sounds good. quick note: keep the pin API backwards-compatible. don't change semantics of ReleasePin when grace present.

olivia: yep. plan to ship as opt-in feature flag and document behavior in /docs/runtime/eviction.md.

mike: :thumbsup: let's track the first week metrics closely and be ready to roll back if grace GC accumulates.
